title: Report on the Indian schools of Manitoba and the North-West Territories

summary: Early report on the Indian residential schools in Manitoba and the Northwest Territories conducted by the Chief Medical Office of the Department of Indian Affairs. The author details the history of the Residential Schools, discusses their condition, and describes the health of the pupils. He finds a high and unacceptable death rate from tuberculosis due to the poor conditions under which the students are forced to live. (This summary is from University of Manitoba Libraries.)
